subject: Delivery and printer issue
text:
Dear Professor,

I need to arrange a delivery. The printer is acting up. The paper tray does not lift. The screen shows a small error. I pressed the button twice. Nothing changed. I turned it off. Then I turned it back on. It still blinks blue. I checked the cable. It feels loose. The delivery team can bring the new feed roller. They can also check the latch. Please send a text if you prefer. I will stay in the lab. The lab room is open until late. I can meet them near the back door. Please tell me when they arrive. I will unlock the side cabinet. I will show them the printer. We can keep it away from the sink. Please reply soon. The door is heavy. The cart may fit. Please warn them. I have a key. I will be patient. I have no rush. The printer is old. It needs care. I do not mind waiting. I just want it fixed. Please help when free.

Thanks
